Remove key '{label}' ({fp}) from the database?

Its {files} file record(s) are removed too. The keyfile and the encrypted files themselves are not deleted.

lock_released_msg:
Someone released the lock on {name} while this change was being saved, so nothing was written.

Merge changes: re-read the latest version and apply this change again (re-login may be required).

{name} is in use by {owner} since {since}.

If that lock is stuck (for example after a crash), you can release it and try again.
